descriptionMarkdown:
Bone ’ead; You gain proficiency in Wisdom saves and one additional skill.

Bone ’ead; Once per short rest, when you or an ally within 10 ft fails a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw against fear, psychic manipulation, confusion, or Suppression, you may use your reaction to let that creature reroll the save.

Bone ’ead; Once per long rest, treat a failed Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw as a success.

Bone ’ead; Allies within 10 ft gain +1 to Wisdom saves while you are conscious.
